name: summon-4-pi
description: PI-Desktop plugins: a hotkey-summoned chat window that wears PI-Desktop's own design tokens (Agent mode on a real host session, or a quick chat with built-in web search) and a transparent floating orb.

scripts.vendor: npm run vendor:morphicons && npm run vendor:curve
scripts.check: node tools/check-plugin.mjs plugins/local.summon-widget && node tools/check-plugin.mjs plugins/local.summon-chat
scripts.pack: node tools/pack-plugin.mjs plugins/local.summon-widget && node tools/pack-plugin.mjs plugins/local.summon-chat
scripts.verify: npm run test && npm run test:vendor && npm run lint && npm run renderer:check && npm run design && npm run check

comment: No "type": "module" on purpose — plugins/local.summon-widget/main.js is CommonJS, and a root-level type:module would make Node treat it as ESM. tools/*.mjs are ESM via their extension.
